meta.title: `status: "active"` on an already-active event with no draft stages runs no service
gaps: No setup recipe creates an active event with no draft stages, no line items, and no config.
The plan cannot verify that no service ran or distinguish an unchanged state from a silent state change.
The operation vocabulary does not expose response-body assertions for a coherent non-500 response.

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for about 20 minutes.
steps: The buyer updates the event with the status set to “active”.
As the buyer, read the event and check that “status” equals active.
words.expected: The app answers cleanly — accepted or refused — but never with a server error. Read back afterwards: “status” equals active.
